name: pairdrop
description: PairDrop(https://github.com/schlagmichdoch/PairDrop) is a sublime alternative to AirDrop that works on all platforms. Send images, documents or text via peer to peer connection to devices in the same local network/Wi-Fi or to paired devices.

variables.name: RATE_LIMIT
variables.description: Set to `true` to limit clients to 100 requests per 5 min

variables.name: WS_FALLBACK
variables.description: Set to `true` to enable websocket fallback if the peer to peer WebRTC connection is not available to the client (see App Setup notes).

variables.name: RTC_CONFIG
variables.description: Path to a json file containing custom STUN/TURN config (see App Setup notes)

variables.name: DEBUG_MODE
variables.description: Set to `true` to debug the http server configuration by logging clients IP addresses used by PairDrop to STDOUT. See here for more info(https://github.com/schlagmichdoch/PairDrop/blob/master/docs/host-your-own.md#debug-mode). Do not use in production!
